title: Ricochet anti-cheat was unable to verify Modern Warfare
desc: Fix verification errors, file integrity checks and when to use Account Recovery after anti-cheat issues.

body.text: “Ricochet anti-cheat was unable to verify your installation” blocks Modern Warfare launch—not always a ban. File corruption, stuck anti-cheat modules, or conflicting software cause most cases.
What the error means
“Ricochet anti-cheat was unable to verify your installation” blocks Modern Warfare launch—not always a ban. File corruption, stuck anti-cheat modules, or conflicting software cause most cases.
Work through verification fixes before assuming HWID enforcement or buying [HWID Spoofer](/products/mw4-cheats/hwid-spoofer/).
Verify game files on PC
Battle.net / Steam → Library → Modern Warfare → Properties → Installed Files → Verify integrity. Let the scan finish completely.
Restart Activision as administrator once. Retry launch before any cheat loader runs—vanilla pass confirms client health.
Restart anti-cheat and PC cold boot
Exit Activision fully—including tray icon. Cold reboot (full power off, not fast restart). Relaunch Activision, wait for cloud sync, then Modern Warfare.
anti-cheat modules sometimes stick after Windows sleep—cold boot clears stuck modules without reinstall.
Remove conflicting software
Disable overlay injectors, old cheat remnants, and kernel debug tools temporarily. Uninstall unused VPN kernel drivers.
Run Modern Warfare vanilla once to confirm anti-cheat passes—then follow [external cheat guide](/blog/mw4-external-cheat-guide/) for clean loader order.
When it is an actual ban
Persistent verify failure on every account after clean reinstall may indicate account restriction. Check Activision profile ban status.
[Account Recovery](/products/mw4-cheats/ugc/) helps structured appeal workflows—not instant unban guarantees. HWID spoof does not fix verify errors from corrupt files.
Loader order after fix
Once Modern Warfare launches clean, read [Ricochet patch day checklist](/blog/ricochet-patch-day-checklist/) before enabling [private modern warfare cheats](/products/mw4-cheats/).
Launch external loader before Modern Warfare per portal guide—reversed order can re-trigger verify on some builds.
After fix: safe return to cheats
Discord support wants verify-error screenshots plus order email if loader fails post-fix. Do not rage-queue Ranked same hour as verify fix—run bot lobby ESP check first.
Conservative presets after any anti-cheat-related error—telemetry spikes after client repairs.
